subject: Dedicated capacity fulfillment orchestration & contract timing
messages:
From: Claire Dawson <claire@acme.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.inference>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.inference
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity for Q4 - timeline & delivery windows

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for last week's demo. As we discussed in the follow-up, Acme is targeting a production-ready dedicated deployment for our inference workloads in early December. Before we get procurement moving I need clarity on realistic shipment and onboarding windows so our legal and ops teams can align on contract dates.

High level asks:
- Firm OEM lead times for the hardware (shipping from vendor to our DC or partner).
- Whether you can tier the delivery (partial cloud reserved capacity first, hardware later).
- Any contract milestones we should lock (hardware delivery date vs service activation).

I've attached a short RFP summary (Acme_RFP_requirements.pdf) showing our expected steady-state throughput and latency SLOs.

Would appreciate a consolidated timeline this week — procurement needs vendor quotes in-hand by Oct 5 to hit the internal budget cycle.

Best,
Claire
Claire Dawson
Head of ML Ops, Acme Research
procure@acme.ai

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.inference>
To: Claire Dawson <claire@acme.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity for Q4 - timeline & delivery windows

Hi Claire —

Thanks for the RFP and the clear asks. Quick summary from Redwood side below and an attached sizing workbook (Redwood_Dedicated_Sizing_v1.xlsx) with the options we used to estimate hardware counts.

High-level options we recommend (based on RFP):
- Option A (Predictable, lower TCO): 40x A800-class GPUs in a dedicated pool — target steady throughput, good for quantized models. OEM lead time estimate: 10–14 weeks from PO to shipping.
- Option B (Hybrid ramp): 24x A800-class now + 24x cloud-reserved nodes (CloudPeak) temporarily for bursts — OEM lead time still for remaining on-prem hardware, but service can start earlier with reserved cloud capacity.
- Option C (Fast-start cloud-heavy): 100% reserved capacity in CloudPeak for initial 3 months; transition to dedicated hardware once OEM shipment completes.

Lead time notes (initial estimates):
- OEM quoting & procurement: 1–2 business weeks to finalize a formal quote once PO terms are agreed; manufacturing lead time ~10–14 weeks typical but depends on the SKU and any custom configs.
- Cloud reserved capacity (CloudPeak): confirmation and reservation can be completed in 2–4 business days; capacity turned on within 48–72 hours after payment/contract execution.
- Redundancy/Onboarding: expect ~2 weeks of configuration, model warm-up and runbooks after hardware arrives; shorter (3–5 days) for cloud-only onboarding.

Draft timeline that maps to your Oct 5 procurement deadline:
- Sep 11–18: finalize OEM quote & PO terms (we'll coordinate).
- Oct 05: ACME internal procurement sign-off (your target).
- Oct 06–Oct 20: issue PO; OEM begins build.
- Nov 16–Dec 14: OEM ships (window depends on exact SKU and shipping location).
- Dec 01–Dec 14: partial service with cloud-reserved nodes if you choose hybrid.
- Dec 10–Dec 24: on-prem onboarding & validation.

I'll coordinate Ben on OEM specifics and ask him to attach the vendor quote summary. Also flagged Marissa to coordinate any contractual carve-outs for SLA/downtime windows.

Aisha Rahman
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0192

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Claire Dawson <claire@acme.ai>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity for Q4 - timeline & delivery windows

Claire, Aisha —

Attaching the preliminary vendor quote I pulled from our OEM partner (OEM_Quote_Sept2026.pdf). A few callouts:
- The quoted SKU is the A800 standard rack node with 8x GPU density per node. Lead-time from PO acceptance to FOB shipping is currently estimated at 12 weeks (low confidence +/- 2 weeks depending on backlog).
- There is an expedited build option that shortens to ~8 weeks at ~8–12% premium, subject to factory capacity.
- Minimum order quantities and customs hold-up estimates are noted in page 3 of the quote.

Operational fallback (if you need earlier capacity):
- Our CloudPeak partner has a pre-reserved burst pool we can activate. Per Suresh at CloudPeak, we can secure a reservation in 2–4 days and activate in 48–72 hours. Link: https://cloudpeak.com/reservations/CP-1892

Ben to-do: confirm exact shipment parity (air vs sea) to Acme's preferred sites and whether OEM will split shipments across two weeks. I'll ask Liam to confirm tomorrow.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Dedicated Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachment: OEM_Quote_Sept2026.pdf

From: Claire Dawson <claire@acme.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.inference>
Cc: procure@acme.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity for Q4 - timeline & delivery windows

Thanks Ben — that helps. A couple of follow-ups from procurement and security:

1) We need a firm ship-by date or a guaranteed shipping window in the contract. Can OEM provide a guaranteed week for shipment with penalties?
2) Data residency and SOC2: our security team needs the SOC2 report and confirmation that logs and telemetry are retained in the US.
3) If we use the hybrid approach, please confirm which components live in our VPC and which are routed through CloudPeak.

I've attached a short SOC2/questionnaire worksheet (Acme_SOC2_questions.xlsx). Legal also asked for a sample SLA and a draft DocuSign for procurement review — if you can provide those links it would be helpful.

Claire

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.inference>
To: Claire Dawson <claire@acme.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity for Q4 - timeline & delivery windows

Claire —

Appreciate the questions. Consolidating answers and next steps below; internal owners assigned inline.

A. OEM guaranteed ship window / penalties — Ben is engaging Liam O'Connor at the OEM to negotiate a shipment window that can be contractually referenced. Redlines we typically accept: a committed ship week with a small liquidated-damages clause for delays >14 days. (Owner: Ben)

B. SOC2 and logs — Marissa will attach our SOC2 Type II summary and a redacted audit log retention spec. We can confirm US-only log retention for your dedicated deployment and include it in the contract appendix. (Owner: Marissa Cole)

C. Hybrid topology & VPC boundaries — Dev has sketched a hybrid topology: model serving and tokenization run in your VPC on dedicated nodes; routing, billing, and fallback orchestration live in Redwood's control plane with explicit egress rules to CloudPeak when bursting. We'll circulate the diagram and network ACLs. (Owner: Dev Patel)

D. Timeline proposal (firm dates to discuss at next call):
- Sep 13–17: finalize OEM terms (Ben/Liam).
- Sep 20: Redwood sends draft SLA and DocuSign link for signature.
- Oct 05: Acme procurement sign-off target.
- Oct 06: PO issue date.
- Oct 06–Oct 13: OEM finalizes build schedule.
- Nov 20–Dec 11: OEM shipping window (best-case based on current backlog/expedite option).
- Nov 01: Cloud-reserved pool live (if hybrid route chosen) — activate for early validation/training.
- Dec 10–Dec 24: final on-prem validation and cutover.

E. Action items (owners & ETA):
- Ben: confirm OEM shipping parity and expedited pricing; provide updated OEM_Quote_Sept2026_rev1.pdf by EOD Sep 14.
- Marissa: upload SOC2 summary & audit-log spec to the shared drive; send link Sep 13.
- Dev: publish hybrid topology diagram + onboarding checklist (Onboarding_Checklist_v0.3.docx) by Sep 15.
- Claire/Acme: confirm whether you want the hybrid fast-start (cloud first) or full dedicated start (Owner: Claire) by Sep 16 to keep Oct 5 procurement cadence.

I'll set up a 30-min alignment call for Monday Sep 14 to walk the team through the draft SLA and the mutual action plan. Proposed HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/ACME-3249

Thanks —
Aisha Rahman
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Onboarding_Checklist_v0.3.docx
